cases.question: Tornado outbreak in Potter County. Triage critical lifeline infrastructure — which hospitals and power substations fall within the highest-risk tornado zones in the county?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    'Hospital' AS facility_type, 
    h.hex_id, 
    h.hifld_health_hospitals_n AS facility_count, 
    t.nri_tornado AS tornado_risk
FROM 
    "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h
JOIN 
    "HP_TOR_001" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
JOIN 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
WHERE 
    c."County" = 'Potter County'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Power Substation' AS facility_type, 
    s.hex_id, 
    s.hifld_energy_substations_n AS facility_count, 
    t.nri_tornado AS tornado_risk
FROM 
    "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s
JOIN 
    "HP_TOR_001" t ON s.hex_id = t.hex_id
JOIN 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c ON s.hex_id = c.hex_id
WHERE 
    c."County" = 'Potter County'
ORDER BY 
    tornado_risk DESC;
```

cases.question: Severe flooding in Webb County. How does social vulnerability compound emergency response challenges during an active flood? Identify the highest-priority zones for swift-water rescue deployment.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    "VUL_001"."hex_id",
    "VUL_001"."inv_median_income",
    "VUL_002"."sovi",
    "EX_POP_001"."population_7km",
    "EX_BLD_001"."building_count",
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N"."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n",
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N"."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n",
    "EX_LIFE_004"."hospital_per100k"
FROM 
    "VUL_001"
JOIN 
    "VUL_002" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "VUL_002"."hex_id"
JOIN 
    "EX_POP_001" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "EX_POP_001"."hex_id"
JOIN 
    "EX_BLD_001" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "EX_BLD_001"."hex_id"
JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N"."hex_id"
JOIN 
    "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N"."hex_id"
JOIN 
    "EX_LIFE_004" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "EX_LIFE_004"."hex_id"
JOIN 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" ON "VUL_001"."hex_id" = "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"."hex_id"
WHERE 
    "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"."County" = 'Webb County'
ORDER BY 
    ("VUL_001"."inv_median_income" + "VUL_002"."sovi" + "EX_POP_001"."population_7km" + "EX_BLD_001"."building_count") /

     "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N"."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n" +

cases.question: Major flooding in Harris County. Which infrastructure-dense areas face the greatest flood exposure? Identify substations and water treatment plants in high flood-risk zones.

SELECT 
    h.hex_id,

    hf.nri_riverine_flood,
    es.hifld_energy_substations_n,
    wtp.hifld_water_wtp_n,

    (es.hifld_energy_substations_n + wtp.hifld_water_wtp_n) AS infrastructure_count

JOIN 
    HP_FLD_002 hf ON h.hex_id = hf.hex_id

JOIN 
    "HIFLD-WATER-WTP-N" wtp ON h.hex_id = wtp.hex_id
WHERE 
    h."County" = 'Harris County'
ORDER BY 
    flood_risk_score DESC, infrastructure_count DESC;
```
